name: Sad_1
short_caption: The robot sadly tilts its head and brings its right hand to its face, then lowers its arm while looking downcast.
movement_description: The robot begins by tilting its head to the side and slightly down while raising its right arm in a curved arc. It brings its right hand close to its face/eyes as if wiping away a tear or hiding its face in sadness. After a brief pause in this pose, it slowly lowers its right arm back to its side while its head gradually returns to the center, ending in the neutral rest posture.
